posts.title: Seniority in the AI era is knowing what to delete
posts.description: In today's AI era, it's easy to generate huge amounts of code, PowerPoint slides, documentation, email replies, you name it. Everything is so noisy and bloated because people copy-paste output from their agent chats and think they are done. I see more confusion across the teams and people at work, like never before. posts.title: The rare skills that never show up on a CV
posts.description: In more than 10 years in IT I have worked with a lot of different types of people. I have also read at least a thousand CVs. They always list the usual stuff. Programming languages, tools, years of experience. Never the rare skills. I have always wondered how hard it is to describe the ones that actually separate you from the rest.
